## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] refactor: no behavior change
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] build / ci / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and pass (`uv run task test`,
      `npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build`)
- [ ] No IP, user-agent, e-mail, token or user id reaches logs or the
      database
- [ ] No request goes to a third-party host (fonts, CDN, analytics)
- [ ] Schema changes come with an Alembic migration
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## Unreleased`
